brief: The canvas is a perpetual, flowing stream of semi-transparent characters, constantly creating and dissolving in an amorphous, swirling vortex. These letters shift in color and density, creating a mesmerizing current that flows across the screen. When the letters encounter the cursor, the flow temporarily changes structure, building pockets of legible text. This structural clarity is unstable; the organized words then visibly scatter and fade out, returning the field to its ceaseless, rhythmic chaos. The movement and density of the visible script are directly controlled by the viewer's proximity and speed of interaction with the canvas.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing tapestry of flowing characters that morph between chaotic motion and structured clarity. Like threads weaving through time, the characters form a perpetual vortex, their semi-transparent forms shifting in hue and density across the canvas. When the cursor approaches, the flow momentarily organizes into legible text before dissolving back into disorder, echoing the ephemeral nature of memory itself. The visual experience is further enhanced by an underlying crystalline wave pattern that pulses beneath the surface, creating a sense of depth and rhythm that connects the fluid motion to geometric harmony, as if the very air were crystallizing into script.
